parsed.notes: Lens B only; support and quote-fidelity issues were not adjudicated.

reasons: Lake identity record is verified for Salinas v. Texas, U.S. Supreme Court, decided 2013-06-17, docket 12-246.
Lake citations include 570 U.S. 178, 133 S. Ct. 2174, 186 L. Ed. 2d 376, 2013 U.S. LEXIS 4697, and 2013 WL 2922119.
Lake treatment field_i_validity is good_law, so Lens B finds no disclosed live-law defect.
residual_risks: Official citation selection failed closed in the lake provenance, but that is a citation-display issue, not a disclosed currency defect.

reasons: Support merits are outside Lens B.
For current-law purposes, lake treatment says good_law and the scope note says the express-invocation holding governs.
residual_risks: No Lens A support or quote-fidelity review performed.

reasons: Home-role support is outside Lens B.
No disclosed final overruling, abrogation, or supersession prevents the case from being used as live Fifth Amendment invocation authority.
residual_risks: No review of whether the target home page should classify this as Key — Progeny.

reasons: Lake identity court_level is scotus and court is U.S. Supreme Court.
A U.S. Supreme Court decision with lake treatment good_law supports the Binding — SCOTUS weight label.
The fractured-opinion limitation is separately disclosed in the treatment scope note.
residual_risks: Binding weight should be read with the scope note because the lead opinion was a plurality.

defect.problem: The good_law treatment call is supported by the lake core treatment field, but the disclosed derivation also says the top-cited treatment lane hit a cap and requires an R15 audit. The page presents the status as clean good law without that audit caveat.
defect.proposed_fix: Retain good_law, but add a treatment caveat noting the pending R15/top-cited audit, or complete that audit before displaying the status without qualification.

reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity is good_law and point_overrides is empty.
All disclosed negative treatment edges are proposed and have field_iii set to mentioned, so they do not by themselves establish overruling or abrogation.
However, lane2_top_cited has cap_hit true and audit_needed true, creating a disclosed treatment-currency caveat.
residual_risks: The unresolved audit could uncover a point-specific limitation or stronger negative treatment not reflected in the current good_law field.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Surface the fractured-opinion scope note and pending-audit caveat next to the displayed good-law badge.
